Product Title:
SmartFit Pro X1 Smartwatch

Short Marketing Description:
Stay connected and in control of your wellness with the SmartFit Pro X1 Smartwatch, featuring a vibrant 1.9-inch AMOLED display, Bluetooth calling, advanced health tracking, and dependable 7-day battery life.

Key Features:
- 1.9-inch AMOLED display
- Bluetooth calling support
- 7-day battery life
- Heart-rate monitoring
- Sleep tracking
- IP68 waterproof protection
- Fitness activity tracking

Promotional Tagline:
Stay fit. Stay connected.
